description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Web Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)


Contract | Remote


We’re looking for an AI web engineer who can both ship high-quality websites using tools like Claude Code and help us build a repeatable, scalable workflow for how we develop sites.

This role is hands-on. You’ll be building real client websites while also shaping how we do it as a team.


What you’ll do

  • Build production-ready marketing websites and web experiences using AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, etc.)
  • Work directly from Figma designs and help define a clean Figma → code handoff process
  • Operate in a fast, iterative “vibe coding” style — rapid prototyping, refining, and shipping
  • Identify patterns across projects and turn them into reusable components, structures, and prompts
  • Help establish a repeatable blueprint for how we build websites with AI (structure, tooling, QA, deployment)
  • Collaborate with design and engineering to continuously improve speed and quality


What we’re looking for


  • 4–5 years of experience in web development / frontend engineering
  • Strong experience as a web engineer / frontend developer
  • Proven ability to ship complete websites (not just components or partial work)
  • Experience using AI tools in development workflows (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)
  • Comfortable working from Figma and translating designs into clean, production-ready code
  • Solid fundamentals in modern web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, frameworks as needed)
  • Experience supporting website migration or rebuild projects using AI-assisted workflows, including translating existing websites into cleaner, scalable frontend structures while maintaining design quality, SEO, performance, and maintainability.
  • Ability to move fast, iterate, and make pragmatic decisions
  • Interest in systematizing workflows , not just building one-off projects


Nice to have


  • Experience creating internal tooling, templates, or developer workflows
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
  • Experience working in agency or fast-paced product environments
  • Strong taste in UI implementation and attention to detail


What success looks like


  • You can take a Figma file and turn it into a live, polished website quickly using AI
  • You reduce build time across projects by introducing better workflows and patterns
  • You help turn “vibe coding” into a structured, repeatable system
  • The team can build faster and more consistently because of your contributions


About the role

  • Hands-on engineering role (this is not a pure systems or ops position)
  • High ownership and autonomy
  • Focus on speed, quality, and repeatability

A passion for efficiency, high availability, and delivering top-tier technical solutions.

title: Remote Chemistry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Chemistry Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Chemical Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing chemistry-centered discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated data, identify chemical relationships, infer reaction rules and molecular behaviors, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes under varying conditions. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in chemistry, quantitative analysis, and scientific methodology to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like

  • Designed chemistry-based reasoning scenarios using experimental results, molecular data, and simulated chemical systems.
  • Authored multi-step tasks involving reaction analysis, chemical property inference, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on pattern discovery, reaction mechanisms, model selection, and scientific consistency checks.
  • Created deterministic solutions, reference explanations, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in chemistry, chemical research, scientific computing, laboratory analysis, or related analytical fields.
  • Applied strong knowledge of chemical principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, and data interpretation.
  • Utilized expertise in experimental design, reaction mechanisms, stoichiometry, thermodynamics, kinetics, or simulation-based analysis.
  • Communicated complex chemical concepts, assumptions, and findings through clear and structured documentation.
  • Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.


Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 12 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)



Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 12 months

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para B2B SDR / Appointment Setter — Remote LATAM em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

B2B Appointment Setter


Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month + $50 USD per qualified booked call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $3,250+/month, uncapped)


Apply Here to Stand Out: (


Connect With Us:


  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 


This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


The Opportunity:


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter


Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role

You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped

The Package: What's In It for You

Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per qualified booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.


Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 12 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)



Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 12 months

B2B Appointment Setter


Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month + $50 USD per qualified booked call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $3,250+/month, uncapped)


Apply Here to Stand Out: (


Connect With Us:


  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 


This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


The Opportunity:


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter


Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role

You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped

The Package: What's In It for You

Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per qualified booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.


Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 12 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)



Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 12 months

You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role

You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.


Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 12 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)



Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 12 months

Cientista de Dados - Remoto

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Salary - 120,898 BRL Annually

Fully Remote

Start Date - ASAP, need immediate joiners


Must Haves:

Enterprise PM experience: 2–4+ years managing large, high-risk IT projects (data, infrastructure, or application development) in global environments

Strong, assertive PM leadership: Proactive “activist” PM who can drive projects forward, make tough decisions, and push back when needed

Proven experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe preferred), with flexibility to work across Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid environments

Full lifecycle ownership: Ability to manage scope, timelines, budgets, and cross-functional teams across multiple concurrent projects (often 3–4 at a time)

Strong communication & stakeholder management: Confident interacting across all levels, building relationships, driving accountability, and facilitating Agile ceremonies

Bilingual (English, Spanish, Portugues)

Financial background

Nice to Haves:

Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe Scrum Master, CSM/PSM, or other Agile certifications

Tools & platforms: Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, PowerBI, and collaboration tools like Miro/whiteboarding tools

Technical breadth: Exposure to both cloud and on-prem IT initiatives

Change management experience: Background in organizational change, adoption strategies, or transformation initiatives

Day to Day:

A client of Insight Global is seeking a Project Manager to join their team remotely. This individual will manage 3–4 concurrent enterprise IT projects across data, infrastructure, and application development. Day-to-day, they will drive delivery across Agile/Scrum, SAFe, and hybrid teams, lead standups and stakeholder updates, track budgets and timelines, and ensure scope alignment. They will proactively mitigate risks, enforce accountability, and communicate effectively across global teams in English and Spanish/Portuguese.

title: 5Y+ Experienced Executive Assistant to VC General Partner (Finance/VC Background)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para 5Y+ Experienced Executive Assistant to VC General Partner (Finance/VC Background) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Brandon is a General Partner at a US venture capital firm. His days run on deal flow, portfolio relationships, and building his network at a high level.

The EA who steps into this role gets direct access to the operational layer of an active VC firm. You see how a GP thinks, where his attention goes, and how high-value investor relationships are managed day to day.

This starts at 20 hours per week. For the right person, the ramp to full-time is built into the offer.

———

Must Haves

  • 5+ years as a remote EA supporting a venture-backed tech founder or a finance executive at a VC or investment firm
  • Near-native written and spoken English
  • Hands-on with CRM tools like Affinity or Attio
  • Active experience managing LinkedIn content, Canva design, and newsletter or blog writing
  • Confident building and maintaining spreadsheets and databases in Excel, Google Sheets, or Airtable
  • Coordinated logistics for in-person or online networking events end-to-end: invites, vendor coordination, and post-event follow-up
  • Comfortable operating with limited structure, taking initiative, asking the right questions, and building process where none exists
  • Professional workstation: high quality webcam, background, stable internet (25 Mbps+), and a quiet dedicated workspace

———

Nice to Haves

  • Prior background inside a venture capital, private equity, or finance-adjacent firm
  • Familiarity with tools like Notion, Superhuman, or other founder-stack productivity software
  • Familiarity with the early-stage / pre-seed venture world, including deal flow and how a GP manages investor and founder relationships
  • Experience managing a founder's or exec's personal brand and social growth

———

Core Responsibilities

  • Manage Brandon's inbox, calendar, and contacts (CRM) so his time stays on deals and relationships
  • Run his content presence across LinkedIn publishing, newsletter coordination, and Canva assets
  • Coordinate networking events end to end, from invites and vendor logistics to follow-up
  • Build and document process, spotting gaps in recurring work, asking questions, and drafting SOPs

———

Expectations

  • Full overlap with US Pacific business hours
  • Part-time start at 20 hours per week

title: Webflow Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

Job Description

Job Title: Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM)

Job Type : Contractor | Remote

Eligible Locations : Mexico, Costa Rica, Panama, Dominican Republic, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Uruguay, Jamaica, Bahamas, and Barbados.



About the Role

We’re looking for remote contributors to help support the development of next-generation AI and robotics systems through smartphone-based video and motion data collection.

This is a flexible, paid remote opportunity where you’ll record simple real-world activities using your smartphone while following clear recording guidelines.

No advanced technical background is required, but attention to detail and consistency are important.


What You’ll Do

  • Record short videos of physical activities using your smartphone
  • Capture synchronized motion and video data during recording sessions
  • Follow simple step-by-step recording instructions and quality guidelines
  • Submit a minimum of 10 hours of approved video data per week
  • Communicate with the team regarding recording quality or task instructions
  • Complete a quick onboarding and device compatibility check

Requirements

  • Access to a compatible smartphone:
  • iPhone 11 or newer
  • Google Pixel 6 or newer
  • Samsung Galaxy S21 or newer
  • Ability to use a smartphone head strap for hands-free recording within 48 hours of onboarding
  • Comfortable performing repetitive movement-based recording tasks
  • Reliable internet connection and communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured instructions
  • Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration.


Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week .


Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding.


Equipment Requirements

Mobile:

Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks.


Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement

Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

description:

Job Description

Job Title: Video Data Entry Specialist (LATAM)


Job Type: Contractor


Location: Remote - experts based in Latin America and the Caribbean. Selected countries include:

Mexico, Costa Rica, Panama, Dominican Republic, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Uruguay, Jamaica, Bahamas, and Barbados


Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Capture precise motion data using your smartphone’s IMU sensors during specified physical activities.
  • Record synchronized video footage to ensure data accuracy and enhance the integrity of all collected motion data.
  • Follow detailed technical protocols to consistently meet strict quality, labeling, and determinism standards.
  • Deliver a minimum of 10 hours of high-quality, approved video data each week throughout the project’s duration.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with the team to clarify requirements and share insights on data collection practices.
  • Maintain timely and reliable delivery of your outputs, aligned with project milestones and expectations.
  • Participate in device compatibility checks and an innovative, AI-enabled interview process as part of onboarding.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Access to a head strap to be able to record both hands within 48 hours of the start date.
  • Supported devices include the iPhone 12 and later, Google Pixel 6 and later, and Samsung Galaxy S21 and later.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a proven record of following standardized protocols.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently manage output and meet deadlines in a dynamic, data-driven environment.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills essential for documentation and remote collaboration.
  • Advanced tech-savviness and experience with mobile devices for sensor and video data capture.
  • Physical ability to engage in repetitive movement tasks safely and effectively.
  • Access to a compatible smartphone capable of high-fidelity data collection.
  • Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background in robotics, kinesiology, sensor-based data collection, or related technical disciplines.
  • Experience with human motion analysis, activity segmentation, or machine learning dataset labeling.
  • Familiarity with structuring large-scale datasets for AI and robotics applications.



Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week .


Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding.


Equipment Requirements

Mobile:

Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks.


Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para 5Y+ Experienced Executive Assistant to VC General Partner (Finance/VC Background) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Brandon is a General Partner at a US venture capital firm. His days run on deal flow, portfolio relationships, and building his network at a high level.

The EA who steps into this role gets direct access to the operational layer of an active VC firm. You see how a GP thinks, where his attention goes, and how high-value investor relationships are managed day to day.

This starts at 20 hours per week. For the right person, the ramp to full-time is built into the offer.

———

Must Haves

  • 5+ years as a remote EA supporting a venture-backed tech founder or a finance executive at a VC or investment firm
  • Near-native written and spoken English
  • Hands-on with CRM tools like Affinity or Attio
  • Active experience managing LinkedIn content, Canva design, and newsletter or blog writing
  • Confident building and maintaining spreadsheets and databases in Excel, Google Sheets, or Airtable
  • Coordinated logistics for in-person or online networking events end-to-end: invites, vendor coordination, and post-event follow-up
  • Comfortable operating with limited structure, taking initiative, asking the right questions, and building process where none exists
  • Professional workstation: high quality webcam, background, stable internet (25 Mbps+), and a quiet dedicated workspace

———

Nice to Haves

  • Prior background inside a venture capital, private equity, or finance-adjacent firm
  • Familiarity with tools like Notion, Superhuman, or other founder-stack productivity software
  • Familiarity with the early-stage / pre-seed venture world, including deal flow and how a GP manages investor and founder relationships
  • Experience managing a founder's or exec's personal brand and social growth

———

Core Responsibilities

  • Manage Brandon's inbox, calendar, and contacts (CRM) so his time stays on deals and relationships
  • Run his content presence across LinkedIn publishing, newsletter coordination, and Canva assets
  • Coordinate networking events end to end, from invites and vendor logistics to follow-up
  • Build and document process, spotting gaps in recurring work, asking questions, and drafting SOPs

———

Expectations

  • Full overlap with US Pacific business hours
  • Part-time start at 20 hours per week

———

Compensation & Perks

  • $15–$20/hr USD based on experience, starting at 20 hours per week
  • After demonstrated performance and fit, hours ramp to 40 per week
  • Direct exposure to how an active VC fund runs, working alongside the GP
  • Fully remote, long-term role with room to grow as responsibilities expand

———

Brandon moves fast and expects his EA to stay ahead of him. If you thrive without a task list, can work out loud under real pressure, and know how to manage the operational back end of a busy investor — apply before the deadline.

title: Video Content Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Content Intern em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: Internship, 6 hours/day (30 hours/week)

Compensation: R$2,000/month

About the Role

We're an early-stage stealth startup in the health and wellness space, building our brand from the ground up. We're looking for a creative, fast-moving video intern who can turn raw footage and ideas into scroll-stopping short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and ads. You'll work directly with the founder and play a key role in how our brand shows up on video. Great opportunity for someone early in their career who loves editing and wants real ownership over content that thousands of people will see.

What You'll Do

  • Edit short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid ads (15-60 second formats)
  • Turn influencer footage, raw clips, and simple briefs into polished, platform-ready videos
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and light motion to make content engaging
  • Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats and cuts
  • Format and optimize videos to spec for each platform
  • Help maintain an organized library of footage and assets
  • Occasionally create simple graphics or thumbnails to support video content

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken. The interview will be conducted in English.
  • Strong editing skills in CapCut, and/or CapCut, Premiere, or similar (essential)
  • A real sense for what makes short-form video engaging, hooks, pacing, retention
  • Fast turnaround, comfortable producing multiple edits per day
  • Organized and reliable with deadlines
  • Self-motivated; you'll get briefs and direction, but we want someone who brings ideas
  • Available 6 hours per day

Nice to Have

  • Experience editing for health, wellness, fitness, or DTC/e-commerce brands
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills
  • An eye for trends, you watch a lot of TikTok and know what's working right now

What You'll Get

  • Real, hands-on experience producing content for a brand from day one
  • Direct mentorship from the founder
  • Flexible remote work
  • Room to grow into a larger creative role as the company scales


How to Apply

In your resume, add a link to a reel or portfolio of your video work, ideally short-form social content you've edited.

title: Junior Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Junior Developer (Software Engineering & Core API Operations)

Location:  100% Remote (Must reside in Brazil)

Liaison Hub:  Abu Dhabi, UAE

Company:  Next Match AI LLC

Reference ID:  NMAI-JDEV-BR-023

The Opportunity

Next Match AI LLC  is seeking a highly motivated, adaptable Junior Developer  to join our distributed global software engineering team. As our automated AI matching networks and foundational HR API  infrastructure experience rapid commercial adoption across North America and the GCC, we are expanding our core technical team to support feature deployment, database optimization, and high-volume data validation holds.

Operating completely remote from within Brazil, you will work alongside senior software architects to write clean code, squash system bugs, and optimize front-end and back-end modules. You will play a vital, hands-on role in scaling our cloud ecosystems, collaborating directly with our core engineering and innovation hub in Abu Dhabi .

Key Responsibilities
  • Feature Development & Maintenance:  Write clean, testable code to build and refine responsive user interfaces and backend logic layers.
  • API Integration Support:  Assist in maintaining and documenting our core HR API  pathways, ensuring reliable data handshakes with third-party corporate client environments.
  • Bug Remediation:  Actively identify, debug, and resolve front-end layout shifts and server-side script errors to ensure a seamless web experience.
  • Database Optimization:  Write and optimize basic database queries, assisting senior engineers with structured data management and transactional logging.
  • Technical Documentation:  Keep internal engineering docs, API logs, and deployment workflows meticulously updated to support codebase transparency.
Who You Are (Requirements)
  • Proven Foundation Experience:  1+ years of professional software development experience, a dedicated internship background, or a robust portfolio of live full-stack web applications.
  • Core Tech Stack Familiarity:  Hands-on exposure to modern front-end tools (JavaScript/TypeScript, React, or Vue) and backend environments (Node.js, Python, or equivalent framework logic).
  • Database & Git Comfort:  Fundamental understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and solid familiarity with version control protocols (Git/GitHub).
  • Strong Problem-Solving Drive:  A sharp analytical mindset with an eagerness to learn complex cloud architectures under the mentorship of senior engineers.
  • Excellent Communication:  Clear, structured verbal and written English communication skills; a natural ability to collaborate effectively across remote, distributed channels. (Portuguese language capability is your native framework; English is required for architecture syncs).
  • Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical coding boot camp credentials).
Premium Compensation & Benefits

We offer a high-tier early-career compensation portfolio built to secure the region's brightest rising tech talent, positioned strictly 20% above the Brazilian market average .

  • Base Salary:  R$ 8,400 – R$ 10,500 BRL per month  (Paid out via equivalent USD stable contract options of $1,600 – $2,000 USD , dependent on portfolio depth and technical evaluation performance).
  • Remote Excellence:  100% remote workflow autonomy paired with a dedicated personal technology stipend and home-office equipment setup allowance.
  • Health & Wellness:  Comprehensive, high-tier medical insurance coverage provided fully for you and your immediate family members.

(Salary and benefits to be discussed based on experience and fit.)

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Virtual Assistant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sales Virtual Assistant — Appointment Setting & Closing for a US CEO (Remote)

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place sales-driven Virtual Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.


Your #1 job: make sure deals close. Appointment setting, direct sales, follow-up that doesn't quit. From there it widens — hiring providers, dispatching, customer satisfaction, finding new ways to grow the business. We're not hiring an assistant. We're hiring a mini-CEO who makes the big CEO's life bigger.


This role is for people who take the reins. Nobody is going to hand you a checklist every morning. You see the gap, you close the gap. If you need to be told what to do next, stop reading — this will frustrate both of us.


The pay grows when you do:

  • Start at $1,000/mo
  • Hit your first KPI → $1,250/mo
  • Hit the next → $1,400/mo
  • Performance bonuses from the business owner on top — up to $400/mo more


The ceiling moves because you move it. We don't cap people who produce.


What you need to have:

  • Fluent, clear, neutral English — easy for a US homeowner to understand on a call
  • Proven sales or appointment-setting background (show us the receipts)
  • Comfortable owning a number, not just doing tasks
  • Cold calling experience — you'll be on the phone, this isn't optional


The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

  • Able to work US business hours (any zone, PST–EST)
  • Up to 50 hours/week. This is firm.
  • Saturday mornings when the business needs it
  • Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking. We use it for transparency, not to micromanage or punish — that's not how we operate. But it's part of the job.


If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. We're filling this seat now. Hit Easy Apply today. If you're a fit, you'll hear from us within 48 hours — we move fast when we find the right person.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.

At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Video Content Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Content Intern em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: Internship, 6 hours/day (30 hours/week)

Compensation: R$2,000/month

About the Role

We're an early-stage stealth startup in the health and wellness space, building our brand from the ground up. We're looking for a creative, fast-moving video intern who can turn raw footage and ideas into scroll-stopping short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and ads. You'll work directly with the founder and play a key role in how our brand shows up on video. Great opportunity for someone early in their career who loves editing and wants real ownership over content that thousands of people will see.

What You'll Do

  • Edit short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid ads (15-60 second formats)
  • Turn influencer footage, raw clips, and simple briefs into polished, platform-ready videos
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and light motion to make content engaging
  • Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats and cuts
  • Format and optimize videos to spec for each platform
  • Help maintain an organized library of footage and assets
  • Occasionally create simple graphics or thumbnails to support video content

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken. The interview will be conducted in English.
  • Strong editing skills in CapCut, and/or CapCut, Premiere, or similar (essential)
  • A real sense for what makes short-form video engaging, hooks, pacing, retention
  • Fast turnaround, comfortable producing multiple edits per day
  • Organized and reliable with deadlines
  • Self-motivated; you'll get briefs and direction, but we want someone who brings ideas
  • Available 6 hours per day

Nice to Have

  • Experience editing for health, wellness, fitness, or DTC/e-commerce brands
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills
  • An eye for trends, you watch a lot of TikTok and know what's working right now

What You'll Get

  • Real, hands-on experience producing content for a brand from day one
  • Direct mentorship from the founder
  • Flexible remote work
  • Room to grow into a larger creative role as the company scales


How to Apply

In your resume, add a link to a reel or portfolio of your video work, ideally short-form social content you've edited.
